newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-HAKKINEN FASTEST IN BRITISH GP PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HAKKINEN FASTEST IN BRITISH GP PRACTICE.

text.p: Mika Hakkinen topped the practice times for McLaren on Friday but the drivers on his tail demonstrated how close and competitive Sunday's British Grand Prix is likely to be.
Hakkinen, of Finland, clocked a best time of one minute and 22.935 seconds, but less than a second seperated the top six drivers..

For Hakkinen, and McLaren, it was a welcome indication that they could be the force to beat in Sunday's 60-lap race as came home 0.3 seconds ahead of Canadian Jacques Villeneuve in the leading Williams.
Villeneuve's Williams team mate Heinz-Harald Frentzen of Germany was third-fastest ahead of Briton Johnny Herbert in a Sauber and Frenchman Jean Alesi in a Benetton.
Giancarlo Fisichella in a Jordan was sixth with world championship-leading German Michael Schumacher seventh for Ferrari.

World champion Damon Hill of Britain languished down in 20th place in his Arrows on the the day after his team chief Tom Walkinshaw had urged him to improve his performance and show the talent that took him to the title last year.
